    A single-character modification involves changing one character in the string
    to any other ASCII character (from 0 to 127).
    The glint rank is the number of such modified strings that have a glint score
    less than or equal to the glint score of the original string.

    Args:
        s: The input string.

    Returns:
        The glint rank of the string s with salt 89.

            modified_char = chr(char_code)
            if modified_char == original_char:
                continue

            modified_s_list = list(s)
            modified_s_list[i] = modified_char
            modified_s = "".join(modified_s_list)

            modified_score = zyn.glint_score(salt, modified_s)
            if modified_score <= original_score:
                rank += 1
    return rank
